subject.title: [Bug]: plugins doctor reports healthy while an active context engine is quarantined at runtime

question: Should OpenClaw keep `plugins doctor` as a static discovery/loadability check and add effective runtime capability status, or should doctor run a bounded health probe for selected context-engine owners?
rationale: Both paths have different safety, cost, and side-effect contracts; source-level evidence was unavailable to establish an existing intended boundary.

options.title: Separate static and effective health
options.body: Keep doctor side-effect-free and add explicit status/diagnostics for runtime quarantine and fallback selection.

options.title: Probe selected owners in doctor
options.body: Add a carefully bounded selected-capability probe only if maintainers define its isolation, timeout, and side-effect contract.

recommendation.title: Separate static and effective health
recommendation.body: Keep doctor side-effect-free and add explicit status/diagnostics for runtime quarantine and fallback selection.

likelyOwner.reason: The reporter has the only concrete runtime reproduction in the supplied context; code-area ownership still needs a history pass before routing implementation.
